1) Background / Context

The project involves developing a sophisticated RSS Reader application using Rails 6. This application will provide a user-friendly interface for managing and reading RSS feeds, alongside offering a REST-like API for external clients. The system is set up to enhance users' ability to organize, manage, and share content seamlessly.

 2) Objectives

- To create an intuitive platform for reading and managing RSS feeds.
- To implement functionality for extracting full-text articles from partial-content feeds.
- To offer robust podcast support, remembering playback position.
- To facilitate actions on articles, such as starring or marking as read.
- To enable powerful search capabilities with a savable search syntax.
- To support various sharing services and read-it-later options.
- To ensure articles are updated if the original content changes.
- To integrate support for YouTube channels and playlists.
- To allow newsletters to be handled directly within the app.

 3) Stakeholders & Users

- End Users: Individuals utilizing the application to manage their RSS feeds, podcasts, and newsletters.
- Developers: Building and maintaining the system.
- Administrators: Managing subscriptions, user accounts, and system settings.
- Third-party Clients: Applications connecting through the provided API.

 4) Functional Descriptions

- Feed Management: Users can subscribe to, organize, and manage RSS feeds.
- Full-text Extraction: Provides complete article content even for feeds that only offer partial posts.
- Podcast Support: Users can listen to podcasts within the app with playback position saved.
- Automated Actions: Configure actions to automatically process articles (e.g., star, mark as read).
- Search Functionality: Users can perform complex searches and save frequent queries.
- Sharing and Saving: Configure sharing services for quick access to read-it-later options.
- Article Updates: Automatic update of articles if the original source changes, highlighting changes.
- YouTube and Newsletters: Follow YouTube channels and integrate newsletters into the app seamlessly.

 5) Non-Functional Descriptions

- Scalability: Handle large numbers of feeds and users efficiently.
- Security: Protect user data and interactions with secure authentication mechanisms.
- Usability: Ensure the app is user-friendly and accessible.
- Performance: Deliver quick load times and smooth transitions between content.
- Compatibility: Provide a robust API to support third-party applications and integrations.
